notes: Burns (45', printed BURNS) runs down the left side from W 8th; the 462 block outlines west of it carry Hatmaker, Staebler, Storrs and St. Michael, all ending at Burns (T). Burns' crossing with W 6th is NOT picked: W 6th's north face at Burns is at y 7637 and its centreline (55') would be at about y 7810, below the page (paper ends at ~7720). It is not on sheet 460 either (see s460). Evans (60', printed EVANS) runs from W 8th to W 6th in three straight pieces (vertical, slanted SSE, vertical) with bends recorded; Perin ends at it from the east. W 8th (80' printed west of Evans; sheet 464 prints 105' east of Evans) is the viaduct over the tracks ('Bridge over tracks', 'Viaduct 2560 long'); its north face is at or above the top paper edge, so its centreline is from the south face and the bridge parapets. Depot Street (north of W 8th per the key map) is not visible. The middle of the sheet is railroad yard and industrial plants (U.S. Bung Co., S. Obermayer, Mill Creek Distilling branch, White Oil Co.), no streets.
